categories.name: build
categories.evidence: Modifies `.github/workflows/ci.yml` to set top-level GitHub Actions permissions.
categories.rationale: Explicitly limits the workflow `GITHUB_TOKEN` to `contents: read` to enforce least privilege. Upstream already defaults to read-only, but defining it in YAML ensures forks without secure defaults run with minimal permissions and makes the security posture explicit.

categories.name: tests
categories.evidence: Changes CI workflow permissions rather than test harnesses, runners, unit test utilities, or test coverage.
categories.rationale: The PR carries the Tests label but only adjusts GitHub Actions workflow token permissions, which is CI configuration under build rather than test infrastructure.
